title.en: Seedance 2.0 AI Video Generator: Models, Features and Use Cases
title.zh: Seedance 2.0 AI 视频生成模型：功能、参数与使用场景

description.en: Learn about Seedance 2.0 and Seedance 2.0 Fast for text-to-video, image-to-video, first and last frame control, synchronized audio, and storyboard drafts.
description.zh: 了解 Seedance 2.0 与 2.0 Fast 的文生视频、图生视频、首尾帧控制、同步音频与分镜草稿能力。

title.zh: Seedance 2.0 AI 视频生成模型。

description.en: The `seedance-video-generator` Combo uses Seedance 2.0 for text-to-video, image-to-video, first/last-frame control, and synchronized audio. The Fast model accelerates drafts and storyboard clips.
description.zh: `seedance-video-generator` Combo 使用 Seedance 2.0 完成文生视频、图生视频、首尾帧控制与同步音频；Fast 型号用于快速生成草稿与分镜片段。

prompts.en: Animate these first and last frames

value.zh: 文本 · 图片 · 首尾帧

title.en: A video engine organized around shots, motion, and continuity.
title.zh: 围绕镜头、运动与连续性组织的视频引擎。

description.en: Seedance is not a chat model. Its value appears when a creative brief becomes a controlled moving sequence inside the dedicated Combo.
description.zh: Seedance 不是对话模型。它的价值在于通过专用 Combo，把创意简报转化为可控制的动态序列。

description.en: Use when motion, frame control, and audio belong in the final deliverable.
description.zh: 当运动、帧控制与音频都属于最终交付物时使用。

description.en: Use for drafts, shot exploration, and storyboard clips.
description.zh: 用于草稿、镜头探索与分镜片段。

description.en: Start from text, an image, or defined first and last frames.
description.zh: 可以从文本、图片或明确的首尾帧开始。

description.en: The engines do not appear in the main chat dropdown.
description.zh: 这些引擎不会出现在主对话下拉菜单中。

title.en: Quality and speed variants inside one Combo.
title.zh: 同一 Combo 中的质量版与快速版。

description.en: Both models are live through the Combo and do not appear in the main chat dropdown.
description.zh: 两个型号均已通过 Combo 上线，但不出现在主对话下拉菜单。

description.en: Text-to-video, image-to-video, frame control, and synchronized audio.
description.zh: 文生视频、图生视频、帧控制与同步音频。

description.en: Fast drafts and storyboard clips.
description.zh: 快速生成视频草稿与分镜片段。

title.en: Build the video around the production decision that matters.
title.zh: 围绕真正影响成片的制作决策构建视频。

description.en: Each workflow begins with a different kind of control rather than the same generic prompt box.
description.zh: 每条工作流从不同的控制方式出发，而不是共用一个泛化提示框。

title.zh: 文生视频概念片

brief.en: Describe subject, camera movement, scene, and audio intent.
brief.zh: 描述主体、镜头运动、场景与音频意图。

process.en: The full engine turns the production brief into a moving sequence with synchronized audio.
process.zh: 完整引擎把制作简报转换为带同步音频的动态序列。

outcome.zh: 一段可审阅的概念视频。

title.zh: 让关键视觉动起来

brief.en: Provide a source image and define how the scene should move.
brief.zh: 提供原始图片并定义场景如何运动。

process.en: Image-to-video preserves the visual starting point while adding motion.
process.zh: 图生视频在保留视觉起点的同时添加运动。

outcome.en: A motion asset connected to the original artwork.
outcome.zh: 一段与原始视觉保持关联的动态资产。

title.zh: 分镜快速迭代

brief.en: Explore several shot directions before committing to final generation.
brief.zh: 在正式生成前探索多个镜头方向。

process.en: The Fast engine produces draft clips for comparing composition and movement.
process.zh: Fast 引擎生成草稿片段，用于比较构图与运动。

outcome.en: A faster decision on which shot deserves final rendering.
outcome.zh: 更快确定哪个镜头值得进入正式生成。

title.en: Video controls presented as a production workflow.
title.zh: 把视频控制组织成一条制作工作流。

description.en: The Combo provides the correct entry for two live Seedance engines.
description.zh: Combo 为两个已上线的 Seedance 引擎提供正确入口。

title.zh: 文生视频

description.en: Turns a shot description into a generated moving sequence.
description.zh: 将镜头描述转换为生成的视频序列。

title.zh: 图生视频

description.en: Uses a source image as the visual basis for motion.
description.zh: 以源图片作为动态生成的视觉基础。

title.zh: 首尾帧控制

description.en: Defines the visual start and end points of the generated shot.
description.zh: 定义生成镜头的视觉起点与终点。

title.zh: 同步音频

description.en: Supports video generation where sound belongs to the resulting sequence.
description.zh: 支持生成包含同步声音的视频结果。

title.en: Choose the engine by the stage of production.
title.zh: 根据制作阶段选择引擎。

title.en: Choose the full Seedance engine when
title.zh: 适合选择完整 Seedance 引擎

items.en: The clip is intended as a finished or near-finished deliverable.
items.zh: 片段将作为成片或接近成片的交付物。

items.en: Frame control and synchronized audio matter.
items.zh: 帧控制与同步音频很重要。

items.en: You already know the shot direction you want.
items.zh: 你已经明确想要的镜头方向。

title.en: Choose Fast or another route when
title.zh: 这些情况改选 Fast 或其他路径

items.en: You are exploring several storyboard directions.
items.zh: 你正在探索多个分镜方向。

items.en: Speed matters more than final polish in the current round.
items.zh: 当前轮次中速度比最终精细度更重要。

items.en: The deliverable is a still image; use the drawing Combo instead.
items.zh: 交付物是静态图片，应改用画图 Combo。

title.en: Brief, generate, then review the moving result.
title.zh: 明确简报、生成视频，再审阅动态结果。
定义镜头

description.en: Set subject, motion, framing, duration, frames, and audio needs.
description.zh: 明确主体、运动、构图、时长、帧与音频要求。

title.zh: 选择质量或速度

description.en: Use the full model for final work or Fast for early drafts.
description.zh: 成片使用完整型号，早期草稿使用 Fast。

title.zh: 审阅连续性

description.en: Check motion, frames, audio, and brand fit before delivery.
description.zh: 交付前检查运动、帧、音频与品牌适配度。

answer.en: Seedance 2.0 is ByteDance's AI video-generation engine for text-to-video, image-to-video, frame-controlled generation, and synchronized audio.
answer.zh: Seedance 2.0 是字节跳动的 AI 视频生成引擎，支持文生视频、图生视频、帧控制生成与同步音频。

question.en: What does the Fast model change?

answer.en: It prioritizes speed for video drafts and storyboard clips, while the full engine is the better choice for finished or near-finished output.
answer.zh: Fast 优先提高视频草稿和分镜片段的生成速度；完整引擎更适合成片或接近成片的结果。

question.zh: Seedance 可以使用哪些输入？

answer.en: The live Combo supports text-to-video, image-to-video, and generation controlled by first and last frames.
answer.zh: 已上线 Combo 支持文生视频、图生视频，以及由首尾帧控制的视频生成。

question.zh: Seedance 可以生成同步音频吗？

answer.en: Yes. Synchronized audio is part of the confirmed Seedance 2.0 workflow in the built-in Combo.
answer.zh: 可以。同步音频属于内置 Combo 中已确认的 Seedance 2.0 工作流能力。

question.en: What are the Seedance 2.0 model IDs?
question.zh: Seedance 2.0 的 Model ID 是什么？

answer.en: The full model ID is `doubao-seedance-2-0-260128`; the faster variant is `doubao-seedance-2-0-fast-260128`.
answer.zh: 完整型号 ID 是 `doubao-seedance-2-0-260128`；快速版是 `doubao-seedance-2-0-fast-260128`。

title.en: Run Seedance through the video Combo.
title.zh: 通过视频 Combo 使用 Seedance。

description.en: Choose the full engine for finished work or Fast for rapid iteration.
description.zh: 成片选择完整引擎，快速迭代选择 Fast。
